sample_unit: data points (LLM responses scored on readability)
models_evaluated: seven LLM systems (names not reported in text)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM health responses across systems, metrics, and Wikipedia grounding
links.effect: Systems were homogeneous at baseline but significantly heterogeneous under Wikipedia grounding; readability metrics differed significantly in all conditions; grounding yielded inconsistent readability.
links.quote: Systems were statistically homogeneous at baseline but became significantly heterogeneous under Wikipedia grounding, indicating variability in the combination of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (differential readability effects of the same source-grounding instruction across systems).

unlisted_practices: Use metric-specific and language-aware readability thresholds in LLM evaluation protocols
Re-run readability evaluation whenever models or grounding configurations change

screen.reason: The study empirically tests the effect of retrieval-augmented grounding (Wikipedia grounding) compared to baseline responses across LLMs on readability and linguistic accessibility for health communication.
